Which services do they ride, in order? If more than one service runs between the same two stations on a leg, any of them is accepted. Answer as a JSON list of route letters or numbers, for example ["A", "7"].

Answer the question using the image. Think it through, then give the answer as a JSON list of names exactly as written on the map, in order, e.g. ["A", "7"].
End your reply with a final line of the form:
FINAL ANSWER: <answer>
